europe_now.title: European Flights Targeted by Bomb Threats
europe_now.summary: Multiple European flights experienced bomb threats for the second time within a week, leading to diversions and major operational disruptions across the region.

europe_now.title: French National Assembly Rejects Budget Bill
europe_now.summary: The French National Assembly unanimously rejected the proposed budget bill as the country faces widespread nationwide strikes and protests over government policies.

top_stories.title: Security Detentions in Poland
top_stories.summary: Polish authorities have detained six individuals suspected of exporting military components to Russia. The arrests highlight ongoing regional security concerns regarding illegal supply networks.

top_stories.title: European Union Policy and Peace Discussions
top_stories.summary: European and American negotiators are currently discussing potential peace frameworks concerning Ukraine. Meanwhile, European officials maintain a cautious stance regarding the resumption of Russian gas imports.
